issues.title: The page makes many resource requests
issues.whatFound: 250 resource requests were recorded for this navigation.
issues.why: High request counts add network overhead and often indicate excessive third-party or fragmented assets.
issues.recommendation: Audit third-party tags, remove unused assets, and consolidate small resources where practical.

issues.title: JavaScript transfer weight is high
issues.whatFound: 12.21 MB of JavaScript transfer data was exposed by the browser.
issues.why: Large script payloads can delay parsing, execution and interactivity.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused code, split non-critical features, defer third-party scripts and compress production assets.

issues.title: A large fixed overlay obscures page content
issues.whatFound: 2 visible fixed or sticky elements cover more than 35% of the viewport.
issues.why: Large overlays can interrupt the task and hide important context, particularly on smaller screens.
issues.recommendation: Reduce the occupied area, provide an obvious close action, and avoid showing it before users understand the page.
